import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long number_input;
    static long[] power_levels = new long[20];
    static long[] degree_levels = new long[20];

    static long compute_min(long current_value, int level) {
        current_value = Math.abs(current_value);
        if (current_value % power_levels[level] == 0)
            return (current_value / power_levels[level]) * level;
        long q = current_value / power_levels[level];
        long candidate1 = q * level + compute_min(current_value - q * power_levels[level], level - 1);
        long candidate2 = (q + 1) * level + compute_min((q + 1) * power_levels[level] - current_value, level - 1);
        return Math.min(candidate1, candidate2);
    }

    static void main_process() {
        power_levels[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 17; ++i)
            power_levels[i + 2] = power_levels[i + 1] * 10 + 1;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        number_input = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(compute_min(number_input, 18));
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        main_process();
    }
}
